user_query: I'm a car enthusiast and I'm looking for a reliable source to purchase car parts at affordable prices. Can you suggest an online platform that offers a wide range of car parts? It would be great if the platform allows users to download their app for easy access to their products.

TaskList.description: Research online platforms that sell car parts and compare their affordability and range of products.
Identify platforms that have mobile applications available for download.
Compile a list of recommended platforms with their details, including product range and app availability.
